subject: Renewal: rate harmonization + commit shift for NovaFash expansion
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@novafash.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novafash.com>, procurement@novafash.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion ask — price hold for Q3 surge

Hi Stephanie,

We're coming up on the November renewal and have an aggressive product roadmap: we expect a 2.5x inference footprint across our recommendation and search models through Q4. Procurement asked whether Redwood can: 1) hold current host pricing for the first 3 months after renewal while we ramp, and 2) offer a limited uplift discount/credit for committed capacity if we increase from our current commit to a higher band.

Attached is a short summary of expected usage shifts and a rough timeline. From our side we want predictable unit economics while we commit to a multi-quarter expansion. Can you share what options you have for a price hold + staged commit uplift (and any operational onboarding needed for the burst)?

Thanks — Maya
Maya Patel
Head of ML Infrastructure, NovaFash

Attachment: NovaFash_Renewal_Request_20270512.pdf (summary)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya@novafash.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion ask — price hold for Q3 surge

Hi Maya — great to hear about the roadmap, congrats on the growth plans. Short answer: yes, we can structure a short-term price hold plus a staged commit uplift with credits to smooth the ramp.

High-level proposal (draft attached):
- Price hold: keep current hosted unit rate for months 0–3 post-renewal while NovaFash ramps to target usage.
- Staged commit uplift: a 3-band commit (Base / Mid / Peak). If you commit to the Mid band in the renewal, we apply a 10% uplift credit for the first two months after hitting the band; if you move to Peak within 6 months we add a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration time.
- Credits & true-up: credits apply as invoice offsets, true-ups quarterly. Shortfall protections are symmetric — if usage is below Base we prorate.
- Operational: we recommend a joint runbook (canary routing to dedicated pool for heavy tails) and a 2-week pre-warm window before go-live.

I attached a draft term sheet with the commit bands and estimated savings. If this looks directionally right, I can pull a formal quote and route to finance for approval.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm target commit band and desired term length (12/24 months).
2) We finalize term-sheet and get legal/finance approval.
3) DocuSign + PO from procurement.

Happy to jump on a quick call this week to walk through the bands.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0198

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Renewal + expansion ask — pricing optics

Stephanie / Olga,

Looping in for margin review and risk: NovaFash wants a short price hold + staged uplift credits. My initial read: acceptable if we cap the price-protection window to 3 months and require Mid commit at renewal. Questions for finance/legal: what floor do we need on effective ASP to sign off on the credits? Also confirm whether the onboarding credit can be amortized or must be one-time.

Also, what are the operational constraints on rapid burst to Peak? If pre-warm + dedicated routing is required, we should add a short SLA carveout in the term sheet.

Cc’ing Olga for legal language suggestions.

- Sergio
Head of Sales — West, Redwood Inference
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Renewal + expansion ask — pricing optics

Sergio / Stephanie,

We can do this with these guardrails:
- Price hold limited to 90 days post-effective date; any extension requires explicit sign-off.
- Commit bands must be defined by absolute token ranges (we will list them in the final term sheet) and include a rolling 30-day measurement window for band qualification.
- Onboarding credit: one-time credit applied on first invoice after the band is reached (not amortized). Simpler for accounting.
- SLA carveout: pre-warm and routing recommendations will be non-billable professional services up to x hours; add language that burst routing is best-effort with defined escalation path.

If we accept this, I'll prepare redlines and a short addendum for the order form.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Can you: 1) send the final term sheet with the absolute token ranges, 2) include the DocuSign link and final quote, and 3) confirm the invoicing cadence for true-ups? Liam will manage the PO side.
